questions.question: Provide a verifiable source for the portrait of Laplace, identify the artist or engraver and date where known, and document the licence or confirmed public-domain status; keep the attribution synchronized in RU and EN.

localizations.source: Provide a verifiable source for the portrait of Laplace, identify the artist or engraver and date where known, and document the licence or confirmed public-domain status; keep the attribution synchronized in RU and EN.
localizations.ru: Укажите проверяемый первоисточник портрета Лапласа, художника или гравёра, дату создания (если известна) и лицензию либо подтверждённый статус общественного достояния; синхронизируйте атрибуцию в RU/EN.

questions.resolution: Attribution clarified: Jean-Baptiste Paulin Guérin, 1838, Versailles; the reproduction and artwork are in the public domain. https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Pierre-Simon,_marquis_de_Laplace_(1745-1827)_-_Gu%C3%A9rin.jpg

questions.question: Clarify Laplace’s role in establishing the École Normale and the École Polytechnique.
questions.resolution: Corrected: teaching at the École Normale and later influence on École Polytechnique curricula are stated without crediting him with founding both schools. Sources: https://www.ens.psl.eu/en/node/1007 and https://www.polytechnique.edu/bibliotheque/patrimoine/portail-patrimoine/histoire-de-lecole/grandes-periodes-de-lhistoire-de-lecole

localizations.source: Clarify Laplace’s role in establishing the École Normale and the École Polytechnique.
localizations.ru: Уточнить роль Лапласа в создании Высшей нормальной и Политехнической школ.

questions.question: Provide verifiable sources and exact editions for the opening aphorism attributed to Laplace and the dialogue with Napoleon; noting a common attribution or several versions does not itself verify the quotations.

localizations.source: Provide verifiable sources and exact editions for the opening aphorism attributed to Laplace and the dialogue with Napoleon; noting a common attribution or several versions does not itself verify the quotations.
localizations.ru: Укажите проверяемые источники и точные редакции для приписываемого Лапласу афоризма в начале и диалога с Наполеоном; пометки о распространённой атрибуции и нескольких версиях сами по себе не подтверждают цитаты.

questions.question: Clarify the heat-conduction use of the Laplace equation: it describes a stationary temperature distribution in a region without internal heat sources.

localizations.source: Clarify the heat-conduction use of the Laplace equation: it describes a stationary temperature distribution in a region without internal heat sources.
localizations.ru: Уточнить область применения уравнения Лапласа в теплопроводности: оно описывает стационарное распределение температуры в области без внутренних источников тепла.

questions.resolution: Corrected in both editions: in heat conduction, the Laplace equation describes a stationary temperature distribution in a region without internal sources. Evidence: https://github.com/Fuzzy-Technologies/history_math/pull/343#issuecomment-6969775741

questions.question: Attribute the hypothesis on the origin of the Solar System to *Exposition du système du monde* (1796), not to the five-volume *Treatise on Celestial Mechanics* (1799–1825).

localizations.source: Attribute the hypothesis on the origin of the Solar System to *Exposition du système du monde* (1796), not to the five-volume *Treatise on Celestial Mechanics* (1799–1825).
localizations.ru: Отнести гипотезу происхождения Солнечной системы к «Изложению системы мира» (1796), а не к пятитомному «Трактату о небесной механике» (1799–1825).

questions.resolution: Corrected in both editions: the nebular hypothesis is attributed to *Exposition du système du monde* (1796). Evidence: https://github.com/Fuzzy-Technologies/history_math/pull/343#pullrequestreview-5966002342
